title: Tensei shitara Slime Datta Ken 3rd Season: Kanwa - Diablo Nikki
content:
I have a special hate/love relationship with recap episodes. On one hand, I’m binging my Anime every so often, trying to watch and review everything a franchise has to offer, so it does get extremely boring having to sit through a retelling of the same events you just experienced, through an arguably inferior lens. On the other hand, sometimes after coming back from a hiatus, I’d love to recap what I’ve seen before prior to resuming my binge again. This recap episode happened to be the latter.

I remember the previous recap episodes had Veldora yap all over them with sassy commentary. Now that the titlementions Diablo by name, I thought it would have been him, but Veldora was too cheeky and did not like that, so he’s here trying to steal the spotlight undeservingly. not gonna lie, it was distracting having them banter over the recapped events.

It felt like a very unfocused recap to be honest and not just because of the chaotic commentary. They skipped through way too much stuff just to focus on a few punches and fights. No. Give me politics, betrayals, consequences. Give me the Slime experience I have come to expect.

Overall: 6.3/10.
